newsitem.title: UK: Cairn says SOCO accepts offer for Command.
newsitem.headline: Cairn says SOCO accepts offer for Command.

text.p: Cairn Energy Plc said on Thursday that SOCO International Inc. (SOCO) had accepted its agreed offer for Australia's Command Petroleum Holdings Ltd. Cairn said that assuming all Command shareholders accepted its offer, SOCO, which holds a 32.6 percent stake in Command, would hold around 9.5 percent of Cairn's enlarged share capital.
Cairn announced on October 2 it had made an agreed offer for Command, which valued the firm at A$365 million. The offer is scheduled to close on November 22.
Command announced earlier today that major shareholder, Snyder Oil Corp which has a 32.6 percent stake, would accept Cairn Energy's bid.
